$comment: ML-3901 SAG mill twin. Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the mill datasheet, a published power model and the ore's SMC test results; the device sends only what it measures.

identification.model: Select SAG mill, 9.0 m diameter x 4.5 m EGL class (top of the published Select range)
identification.description: Primary SAG mill of the SABC grinding circuit (SAG mill, pebble crusher, ball mill)
identification.drive: Ring gear and single pinion, main reducer, induction motor (fixed speed)
identification.bearings: Two trunnion bearings with hydrostatic lift pockets, one lube system
identification.liners: Steel shell liners with lifter bars, steel head liners, discharge grates and pulp lifters

mill.source: Metso Outotec Select horizontal grinding mills leaflet: SAG 3.80-9.00 m diameter, 1.90-4.50 m EGL, 400-7,800 kW installed; this mill is taken at the top of that range (assumption: typical value, replace with your mill datasheet). Critical speed n_c = 42.3 / sqrt(D) rpm (textbook). Cone-end allowance +5 % (Doll 2013). Design speed 75 % of critical: assumption: typical value, replace with your datasheet.

power_model.source: Austin (1990) SAG power model with K = 10.6, A = 1.03, bed porosity 0.3, charge solids 0.80, balls 7.8 t/m3, as written by Doll (Procemin 2013); motor input to mill shell 0.931 (Doll). Power at the mill shell.

liners.source: Effective shell liner thickness new and at the reline limit, liner mass new, planned liner life in kilotonnes milled (wear assumed linear with tonnage): assumption: typical value, replace with the liner supplier's design and your own wear scans.

mass.source: Rotating mass of the empty mill without liners, and the effective lift area of one trunnion bearing that turns pocket pressure into load: assumption: typical value, replace with the mill datasheet and a bearing pressure calibration at a grind-out (empty mill) and a crash stop.

charge.source: Total filling and ball filling (fractions of mill volume) at design; filling above which the power falls as the load rises. 911metallurgist (AG/SAG control): power drops above about 35-37 % filling. Design fillings: assumption: typical value, replace with your process design.

ore.source: Morrell SMC equation Wa = K1 Mia 4 (750^f(750) - x1^f(x1)), f(x) = -(0.295 + x/1e6), K1 = 0.95 with a pebble crusher. Mia, ore density and feed F80 at design: assumption: typical value, replace with your SMC tests and the ore block model. wa_share = SAG mill specific energy (motor) divided by Wa at the commissioning survey: assumption: typical value, replace with your own survey.

bearings.source: Lube oil supply temperature and normal bearing temperature rise above the oil: assumption: typical value, replace with the bearing maker's manual.

gear.source: Normal pinion bearing vibration and normal temperature difference across the ring gear face (infrared scanner): assumption: typical value, replace with your baseline.

demo.note: Demo only: the plant clock runs 60 times faster so the tonnage counter moves; the charge settles in about 20 s of real time.

points.label: Ring gear temperature difference across the face
Feed P80 (image analysis on the feed belt)
Coarse ore work index Mia of the blend (ore tracking)
Ball filling (tracker: last grind-out + balls added - wear)
Tonnes milled since the last reline
Shell liner thickness at the last laser scan
Tonnes since reline at the last scan

limits.source: Alarm limits: assumption: typical value, replace with your operating practice. Vibration 4.5 / 7.1 mm/s are typical zone boundaries B/C and C/D of ISO 20816-3 for large rigidly mounted machines; take the values for your machine group and support from the standard.

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

charge_overload.name: Mill overload (charge builds up, slurry pools)
charge_overload.symptoms: bearing pressure and filling rise while the power falls below the model

liner_wear_fast.name: Shell liners wearing faster than planned
liner_wear_fast.symptoms: laser scan thinner than the tonnage predicts; reline date moves forward

lifter_profile_loss.name: Lifters worn flat or packed (grinding efficiency loss)
lifter_profile_loss.symptoms: specific energy above the SMC model; throughput down at the same power

ball_overcharge.name: Ball charge too high
ball_overcharge.symptoms: ball filling up, power above the drive rating, more liner and ball breakage

bearing_lube.name: Trunnion bearing lubrication degraded (feed end)
bearing_lube.symptoms: bearing temperature rises above the oil supply, then past its limit

pocket_leak.name: Bearing lift pocket leak or pressure transmitter drift
pocket_leak.symptoms: one bearing pressure falls, the load split moves, the charge estimate goes wrong

gear_misalignment.name: Ring gear / pinion misalignment
gear_misalignment.symptoms: temperature difference across the gear face and pinion vibration rise
